records.name: Survival chapter description
records.plain: Cancer cells can change how they manage damage, recycling and death. A changed process is not automatically a survival requirement. Experiments must test what the relevant cells need under the stated conditions.

records.name: Autophagy stage description
records.plain: Autophagy delivers cellular material to lysosomes for breakdown and reuse. A marker snapshot or KRAS alteration alone does not establish recycling flow or survival dependence. In Yamamoto and colleagues' 2020 pancreatic cancer models, autophagy reduced surface MHC-I, the proteins that display antigens to CD8 T cells.
